name: Stan
description: Creator storefront / “make a living online” platform (stan.store) — link-in-bio commerce for digital products and services.

mentions.evidence: ~$3.57M MRR, ~101.6k active subscriptions, ~$2.84M L30, ~$76.6M all-time. Stripe API key expired; data last updated Apr 20, 2026 — treat as last verified snapshot, not live.
mentions.indieAngle: Proof that a simple creator checkout layer can out-earn almost every “AI wrapper” on the leaderboard.

whyItPrints: Takes a cut of creator checkouts at massive scale. Not glamorous infra — just the cash register creators already need.
